result.instructions: Tools for webCRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which open opportunities are at the proposal stage, and who owns each one?"; "Find the person named Anna de Vries and show her organisation and recent activities."; "List the support cases opened this week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes webCRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run webcrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run webcrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run webcrm_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. webcrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.description: Create a new activity (task, call or meeting) on a person, organisation or opportunity. POST /Activities. Creates a record: no existing data is changed.

date_time.description: ISO 8601 date and time, for example 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z.

assigned_to_user_id.description: webCRM user id the activity is assigned to.
